+# The Subgraph Core and Native Blocks
+
+## Abstract
+
+The entire maximizing set of actual connected-subgraph counts lies in one block.
+
+Dinesh Pandey and Kamal Lochan Patra, Some new central parts of connected graphs, arXiv:2110.00738v1, https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.00738v1, page 9, state: Conjecture 3.25. The subgraph core of a graph G is contained in a block of G. Definition 3.23 on that page counts connected subgraphs containing a vertex. Page 1 specifies finite simple connected undirected graphs, defines a cut vertex by disconnection after deletion, and defines a block as a maximal subgraph with no cut vertex.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (Actual vertex and edge choices).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.subgraphNumber`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.subgraphNumber` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every finite simple graph G and vertex v, subgraphNumber(G,v) is the cardinality of the actual connected subgraphs containing v. It uses countContaining(G,{v}) from DePatraBridge. Each subgraph has its own vertex set and edge set. Distinct edge choices are distinct objects, inducedness is not required, and singleton subgraphs are included.
+
+**Definition 1.2 (The entire maximizing set).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.subgraphCore`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.subgraphCore` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+A vertex v belongs to subgraphCore(G) precisely when subgraphNumber(G,w) is at most subgraphNumber(G,v) for every vertex w of G.
+
+**Definition 1.3 (Maximal connected subgraphs without a cut vertex).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.NativeBlock`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.NativeBlock` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+NoCut(H) means that H is connected and deleting any one vertex leaves no pair of mutually unreachable remaining vertices. Deletion restricts both the actual vertex set and the actual edges. NativeBlock(H) means maximality for NoCut under subgraph inclusion, including both vertices and edges. Empty deletion has no disconnected pair. Thus a one-vertex graph has its singleton block, and a bridge edge is admitted as a block. No order cutoff is imposed.
+
+**Theorem 1.4 (One block contains all maximizers).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Resolves.* `Problems/pandey-patra-2021-subgraph-core` (proved) by `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result`.
+
+<!-- scribe-open-problem-resolution-v1 {"problem_slug":"pandey-patra-2021-subgraph-core","declaration_gid":"D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result","resolution_kind":"proved"} -->
+
+*Citation.* Dinesh Pandey; Kamal Lochan Patra (2021). *Some new central parts of connected graphs*. URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.00738v1>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every finite vertex type V and every connected simple graph G on V, there exists a native block B of G with subgraphCore(G) contained in B.verts. The block is shared by the entire maximizing set.
+
+The counting argument extends a connected subgraph H containing x and omitting r along a path from r to x, stopping at its first encounter with H. Let L be the path before that encounter and K the union of the path with H. Then K contains r and x, L contains r and omits x, and deleting L's vertices from K recovers H, including its edge choices. This injects the x-only subgraphs into pairs consisting of an r-and-x subgraph and an r-only subgraph. Writing d for the former count and a for all r-containing subgraphs gives the bound c <= d(a-d) for the x-only count c.
+
+At a one-vertex separation with root r, write a and b for the local root counts on the two sides, and d and e for the local joint counts at r,x and r,y. Exact gluing gives f(r)=ab, f(x)=c+db and f(y)=h+ea. The path-extension bound gives c <= d(a-d) and h <= e(b-e). The root singletons give d<a and e<b. If both f(x) and f(y) were at least f(r), these inequalities would force b<=d<a<=e<b, a contradiction. Hence maximizers different from r cannot lie in different components after deleting r.
+
+For a maximizing set with at least two vertices, take the union of all simple paths between maximizing vertices. Every vertex on such a path, after deleting a vertex z, can still reach one endpoint different from z along that path. All maximizing vertices different from z are mutually reachable after deleting z by the separation argument, and their connecting simple paths belong to the same union. The induced graph on this union therefore has no cut vertex. A singleton maximizing set starts with its singleton subgraph. Finiteness extends either subgraph to a maximal one.
+

+# A Path Hull Without Cut Vertices
+
+## Abstract
+
+Vertex inseparability produces a connected subgraph without cut vertices.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (A common cover for an unseparated set).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreHull.exists_no_cut_cover`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreHull.exists_no_cut_cover` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Let G be a connected simple graph and S a nonempty set of vertices. Suppose that for every deleted vertex z, every two members of S different from z remain mutually reachable in G-z. There exists a connected subgraph H containing the entire set S such that deleting any vertex from H leaves no pair of mutually unreachable remaining vertices. No finiteness or lower bound on the order is needed.
+
+Take every vertex on any simple path with both endpoints in S, and induce a subgraph on this union. The trivial paths include S. If a vertex x in the union differs from a deleted vertex z, at least one of the two segments from x to its path endpoints avoids z, because the path has no repeated vertex. Thus x can reach a surviving endpoint in S. The hypothesis connects any two surviving endpoints after deletion, and a simple path between them is itself included in the union. Concatenating these paths proves the required reachability. For a singleton S, the union is a singleton; deleting its sole vertex leaves no pair to disconnect.
+
+## References
+

+
+## Abstract
+
+Six explicit rational axes cover the real unit two-sphere by relatively open orthogonality-free sets.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (Real Euclidean three-space).**

+

+

+
+**Definition 1.2 (The standard unit two-sphere).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.UnitSphere`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.UnitSphere` (`✓ std3`).

+

+
+The carrier is Metric.sphere zero one in EuclideanSpace over the reals indexed by Fin 3. It has the ordinary subspace topology and the standard real inner product.
+
+**Definition 1.3 (The six rational axes).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.axis`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.axis` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* David V. Feldman and Alexander Wilce (2026). *A Note on Compactness and Clique Size*. DOI: [10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13320>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+In order, the six vectors are (1,2,0), (1,-2,0), (0,1,2), (0,1,-2), (2,0,1), and (-2,0,1). Each has squared Euclidean norm five. No normalization or choice of an irrational coordinate is required.
+
+**Definition 1.4 (Strict projection superlevels).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.color`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.color` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* David V. Feldman and Alexander Wilce (2026). *A Note on Compactness and Clique Size*. DOI: [10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13320>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For each index i in Fin 6, the corresponding subset consists of all actual unit vectors x satisfying 5 < 2 times the square of the inner product of x with axis i. These are subsets of the entire sphere.
+
+**Theorem 1.5 (An open orthogonality-free cover).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.rational_six_axis_open_cover`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover.rational_six_axis_open_cover` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Acknowledgement.* David V. Feldman and Alexander Wilce (2026). *A Note on Compactness and Clique Size*. DOI: [10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2608.13320). URL: <https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.13320>.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+All six subsets are open in the sphere, each excludes every orthogonal pair of unit vectors, and their indexed union is the entire sphere. Openness follows from continuity of the inner product and the strict inequality. For orthogonal unit x and y, the two-vector Bessel inequality gives the sum of their squared projections onto any one axis at most five; membership of both would make that sum greater than five. The proof uses Mathlib's Orthonormal.sum_inner_products_le. For coverage put a=abs(x0), b=abs(x1), c=abs(x2), Q=a squared plus b squared plus c squared, and M=max(a+2b,b+2c,c+2a). Write u=M-a-2b, v=M-b-2c, and w=M-c-2a. All these quantities are nonnegative. The exact identity is 3 M squared - 9 Q = uv+vw+wu+6(aw+bu+cv)+((a-b) squared+(b-c) squared+(c-a) squared)/2. Thus M squared is at least 3 Q. One of the two signed forms for each coordinate pair has squared value (abs(s)+2 abs(t)) squared. Since Q=1 on the sphere, one of the six squared projections is at least three, which satisfies the strict threshold. This supplies the upper bound six for Feldman--Wilce Question 3. It proves no lower bound and does not determine higher-dimensional covering numbers. Feldman--Wilce supplies the question. The six-set upper bound has classical antecedents in antipodal icosahedral coverings, including Fowler, Tarnai and Gáspár, From circle packing to covering on a sphere with antipodal constraints (2002), DOI 10.1098/rspa.2002.0990. The rational coordinates and polynomial certificate describe this repository implementation; no mathematical novelty or priority is claimed.

+# A symmetric injective matrix-product family with four physical levels
+
+## Abstract
+
+Four physical levels with nonzero charge values admit a normalized, symmetric matrix-product family of bond dimension three that is injective at block length two.
+

+# Complete trivial zero correction
+
+## Abstract
+
+Complete trivial zero correction
+
+The natural index n represents j=n+1. The full coefficient series has mass 1-log(2), and uniform absolute bounds give continuity on the nonnegative half-axis. +private theorem ordinary_monomial (D : LatticeData) (q : ℂ) (d : Occ D) :
+    monomial (fun a : Index D => q ^ (a.2 + 1)) d = q ^ oscillatorEnergy d := by
+  classical
+  unfold monomial Finsupp.prod
+  simp_rw [← pow_mul]
+  rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
+  congr 1
+  simp only [oscillatorEnergy, Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum, nsmul_eq_mul]
+  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Nat.mul_comm _ _)
+
+/-- The unsigned ordinary oscillator sum has the integer-frequency Euler product. -/
+theorem ordinary_oscillator_hasProd (D : LatticeData) (q : ℂ) (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
+    HasProd (fun m : ℕ => ((1 - q ^ (m + 1))⁻¹) ^ D.rank)
+      (∑' d : Occ D, q ^ oscillatorEnergy d) := by
+  let z : Index D → ℂ := fun a => q ^ (a.2 + 1)
+  have hn : Summable (fun d : Occ D => ‖monomial z d‖) := by
+    simpa only [z, ordinary_monomial] using occupation_norm D q hq
+  have hz (a : Index D) : ‖z a‖ < 1 := by
+    dsimp [z]
+    rw [norm_pow]
+    exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq (by omega)
+  have hp := hasProd_inverse_eq_occupation_sum z hn hz
+  have hswap : HasProd (fun p : ℕ × Fin D.rank => (1 - q ^ (p.1 + 1))⁻¹)
+      (∑' d : Occ D, monomial z d) :=
+    (Equiv.prodComm ℕ (Fin D.rank)).hasProd_iff.mpr hp
+  have hg : HasProd (fun m : ℕ => ((1 - q ^ (m + 1))⁻¹) ^ D.rank)
+      (∑' d : Occ D, monomial z d) := by
+    apply hswap.prod_fiberwise
+    intro m
+    simpa using (hasProd_fintype (fun _ : Fin D.rank => (1 - q ^ (m + 1))⁻¹))
+  simpa only [z, ordinary_monomial] using hg
+
+private theorem norm_fin_product {A : Type*} {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A → ℂ)
+    (hf : ∀ a, Summable (fun b => ‖f a b‖)) :
+    Summable (fun v : Fin r → A => ‖∏ a, f a (v a)‖) := by
+  induction r with
+  | zero => exact Summable.of_finite
+  | succ r ih =>
+    have ht := ih (fun a => f a.succ) (fun a => hf a.succ)
+    have hp := (hf 0).mul_norm ht
+    exact (Fin.insertNthEquiv (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => A) 0).summable_iff.mp
+      (by simpa [Function.comp_def, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.insertNth_zero] using hp)
+
+private theorem norm_finite_product {A B : Type*} [Fintype B]
+    (f : B → A → ℂ) (hf : ∀ b, Summable (fun a => ‖f b a‖)) :
+    Summable (fun v : B → A => ‖∏ b, f b (v b)‖) := by
+  let e := Fintype.equivFin B
+  let E : (B → A) ≃ (Fin (Fintype.card B) → A) :=
+    Equiv.piCongrLeft' (fun _ : B => A) e
+  have hs := norm_fin_product (fun k => f (e.symm k)) (fun k => hf (e.symm k))
+  have ht := hs.comp_injective E.injective
+  apply ht.congr
+  intro v
+  change ‖∏ k, f (e.symm k) (v (e.symm k))‖ = ‖∏ b, f b (v b)‖
+  rw [e.symm.prod_comp (fun b => f b (v b))]
+
+private theorem product_norm_lt_one (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    ‖∏ j : Four, z j‖ < 1 := by
+  classical
+  rw [norm_prod]
+  have hle : (∏ j : Four, ‖z j‖) ≤ ∏ j ∈ ({0} : Finset Four), ‖z j‖ :=
+    Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one₀ (by simp)
+      (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j _ _ => (hz j).le)
+  have hle' : (∏ j : Four, ‖z j‖) ≤ ‖z 0‖ := by simpa using hle
+  exact hle'.trans_lt (hz 0)
+
+private theorem side_product_norm_lt_one (M : PM4) (e : edgeParam M)
+    (ε : Fin 2) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    ‖sideProduct z ε e.1‖ < 1 := by
+  classical
+  have hside : ∃ j : Four, sideMem ε e.1 j := by
+    by_cases h : ε.1 = 0
+    · refine ⟨e.1.2, ?_⟩
+      simp [sideMem, h, arcMem, edges_ordered M e.1 e.2]
+    · refine ⟨e.1.1, ?_⟩
+      simp [sideMem, h, arcMem]
+  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hside
+  unfold sideProduct
+  rw [norm_prod]
+  have hle : (∏ a : Four, ‖if sideMem ε e.1 a then z a else 1‖) ≤
+      ∏ a ∈ ({j} : Finset Four), ‖if sideMem ε e.1 a then z a else 1‖ :=
+    Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_le_one₀ (by simp)
+      (fun a _ => norm_nonneg _) (by
+        intro a _ _
+        by_cases h : sideMem ε e.1 a
+        · simpa only [if_pos h] using (hz a).le
+        · simp only [if_neg h, norm_one, le_refl])
+  have hle' : (∏ a : Four, ‖if sideMem ε e.1 a then z a else 1‖) ≤ ‖z j‖ := by
+    simpa [hj] using hle
+  exact hle'.trans_lt (hz j)
+
+private theorem charge_norm (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (S : Finset Four) (q : ℂ) (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
+    Summable (fun β : Charge D =>
+      ‖q ^ (chargeEnergy D β).toNat *
+        ∏ j ∈ S, (bilinear D (unitCharge D (i j)) β : ℂ)‖) := by
+  classical
+  let C : ℝ := ∏ j ∈ S, ∑ a : Fin D.rank, ‖(D.G (i j) a : ℂ)‖
+  have hs := (charge_gaussian_moment D hD ‖q‖ (norm_nonneg _) hq S.card).mul_right C
+  apply hs.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
+  intro β
+  have hb : (∏ j ∈ S, ‖(bilinear D (unitCharge D (i j)) β : ℂ)‖) ≤
+      ∏ j ∈ S, ((∑ a : Fin D.rank, ‖(D.G (i j) a : ℂ)‖) * chargeSize D β) :=
+    Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j _ => bilinear_charge_bound D β (i j))
+  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const] at hb
+  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_prod]
+  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg q)
+    (chargeEnergy D β).toNat)
+  simpa only [C, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hh
+
+private def edgeIndexEquiv : (ℕ × Fin 2 × ℕ) ≃ (Fin 2 × (ℕ × ℕ)) where
+  toFun v := (v.2.1, (v.1, v.2.2))
+  invFun v := (v.2.1, (v.1, v.2.2))
+  left_inv _ := rfl
+  right_inv _ := rfl
+
+private def edgeTerm (D : LatticeData) (i : Four → Fin D.rank)
+    (z : Four → ℂ) (M : PM4) (e : edgeParam M) (v : ℕ × Fin 2 × ℕ) : ℂ :=
+  (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) *
+    markedTerm (∏ j : Four, z j) (sideProduct z v.2.1 e.1) (v.1, v.2.2)
+
+private theorem edge_norm (D : LatticeData) (i : Four → Fin D.rank)
+    (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) (M : PM4) (e : edgeParam M) :
+    Summable (fun v : ℕ × Fin 2 × ℕ => ‖edgeTerm D i z M e v‖) := by
+  let q := ∏ j : Four, z j
+  let g : Fin 2 × (ℕ × ℕ) → ℂ := fun v =>
+    (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * markedTerm q (sideProduct z v.1 e.1) v.2
+  have hs : Summable (fun v => ‖g v‖) := by
+    apply (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun v => norm_nonneg (g v))).2
+    refine ⟨?_, Summable.of_finite⟩
+    intro ε
+    have ht := (marked_summable q (sideProduct z ε e.1)
+      (product_norm_lt_one z hz) (side_product_norm_lt_one M e ε z hz)).mul_left
+      ‖(D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ)‖
+    simpa only [g, norm_mul] using ht
+  change Summable (fun v => ‖g (edgeIndexEquiv v)‖)
+  exact hs.comp_injective edgeIndexEquiv.injective
+
+private theorem matching_source_norm (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) (M : PM4) :
+    Summable (fun x : Charge D × (Occ D × edgeData M) =>
+      ‖sourceTerm D hD i z ⟨M, x⟩‖) := by
+  classical
+  let q := ∏ j : Four, z j
+  have hc := charge_norm D hD i (unpaired M) q (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+  have ho := occupation_norm D q (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+  have he := norm_finite_product (fun e : edgeParam M => edgeTerm D i z M e)
+    (fun e => edge_norm D i z hz M e)
+  have hs := hc.mul_norm (ho.mul_norm he)
+  apply hs.congr
+  rintro ⟨β, d, v⟩
+  rw [source_term_factor]
+  simp only [edgeTerm, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, q]
+  congr 1
+  ring
+
+private theorem source_norm (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    Summable (fun x : sourceIndex D => ‖sourceTerm D hD i z x‖) := by
+  apply (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (fun x => norm_nonneg (sourceTerm D hD i z x))).2
+  exact ⟨matching_source_norm D hD i z hz, Summable.of_finite⟩
+
+private def gradeFiberEquiv (D : LatticeData) (n : Four → ℕ) :
+    {x : sourceIndex D // sourceGradeMap D x = n} ≃
+      Σ M : PM4, sourceFiber D n M where
+  toFun x := ⟨x.1.1, ⟨x.1.2, fun j => congrFun x.2 j⟩⟩
+  invFun x := ⟨⟨x.1, x.2.1⟩, funext x.2.2⟩
+  left_inv _ := rfl
+  right_inv _ := rfl
+
+private theorem grade_fiber_sum (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (n : Four → ℕ) :
+    (∑' x : {x : sourceIndex D // sourceGradeMap D x = n},
+      sourceTerm D hD i z x.1) =
+      (∏ j : Four, z j ^ n j) * actualFourCurrentCycleTrace D hD i n := by
+  classical
+  letI (M : PM4) : Finite (sourceFiber D n M) := source_fiber_finite D hD n M
+  letI (M : PM4) : Fintype (sourceFiber D n M) := Fintype.ofFinite _
+  have he (M : PM4) (x : sourceFiber D n M) :
+      sourceTerm D hD i z ((gradeFiberEquiv D n).symm ⟨M, x⟩).1 =
+        (∏ j : Four, z j ^ n j) * sourceCoefficient D i M x.1.1 x.1.2.2 := by
+    dsimp [gradeFiberEquiv, sourceTerm, sourceCoefficient]
+    have hpow : (∏ j : Four, z j ^
+        sourceGrade D M x.1.1 (oscillatorEnergy x.1.2.1) x.1.2.2 j) =
+        ∏ j : Four, z j ^ n j := by
+      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
+      intro j hj
+      rw [x.2 j]
+    rw [hpow]
+    ring
+  rw [← (gradeFiberEquiv D n).symm.tsum_eq, tsum_fintype, Fintype.sum_sigma]
+  simp_rw [he]
+  simp only [← Finset.mul_sum]
+  rw [actual_four_current_grade_trace]
+  congr 1
+  have hfinite (M : PM4) := tsum_fintype
+    (L := SummationFilter.unconditional (sourceFiber D n M))
+    (fun x : sourceFiber D n M => sourceCoefficient D i M x.1.1 x.1.2.2)
+  simp_rw [← hfinite]
+  simp_rw [matching_fiber_coefficient D hD i n]
+  unfold boundedFourCurrentCoefficient
+  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
+  exact (Finset.sum_subtype (positiveChargeCutoff D hD ((min4 n : ℕ) : ℤ))
+    (fun _ => Iff.rfl) (fun β => ∑ M : PM4,
+      ∑ ell : edgeParam M → Fin (max4 n + 1),
+        ∑ ε : edgeParam M → Fin 2,
+          ∑ k : edgeParam M → Fin (min4 n + 1),
+            ∑ t : Fin (min4 n + 1), chargeWeight D i n β M ell ε k t)).symm
+
+/-- Absolute summability of the original full-grade four-current thermal
+family on every face of the open coordinate polydisk. -/
+theorem original_four_current_thermal_normSummable (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    Summable (fun n : Four → ℕ => ‖(∏ j : Four, z j ^ n j) *
+      actualFourCurrentCycleTrace D hD i n‖) := by
+  have hs := source_norm D hD i z hz
+  have hg := hs.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise (sourceGradeMap D)
+  apply hg.summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
+  intro n
+  rw [← grade_fiber_sum D hD i z n]
+  exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (hs.subtype _)
+
+private theorem original_source_hasSum (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    HasSum (fun n : Four → ℕ => (∏ j : Four, z j ^ n j) *
+      actualFourCurrentCycleTrace D hD i n)
+        (∑' x : sourceIndex D, sourceTerm D hD i z x) := by
+  have hs := (source_norm D hD i z hz).of_norm.hasSum.tsum_fiberwise (sourceGradeMap D)
+  exact hs.congr_fun (fun n => (grade_fiber_sum D hD i z n).symm)
+
+private theorem sum_fin_product {A : Type*} {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A → ℂ)
+    (b : Fin r → ℂ) (hn : ∀ a, Summable (fun v => ‖f a v‖))
+    (hf : ∀ a, HasSum (f a) (b a)) :
+    HasSum (fun v : Fin r → A => ∏ a, f a (v a)) (∏ a, b a) := by
+  induction r with
+  | zero => simpa using (hasSum_fintype (fun v : Fin 0 → A => ∏ a, f a (v a)))
+  | succ r ih =>
+    have hi := ih (fun a => f a.succ) (fun a => b a.succ)
+      (fun a => hn a.succ) (fun a => hf a.succ)
+    have hs := norm_fin_product (fun a => f a.succ) (fun a => hn a.succ)
+    have hp := (hf 0).mul hi ((hn 0).mul_norm hs).of_norm
+    exact (Fin.insertNthEquiv (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => A) 0).hasSum_iff.mp
+      (by simpa [Function.comp_def, Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.insertNth_zero] using hp)
+
+private theorem sum_finite_product {A B : Type*} [Fintype B]
+    (f : B → A → ℂ) (b : B → ℂ) (hn : ∀ a, Summable (fun v => ‖f a v‖))
+    (hf : ∀ a, HasSum (f a) (b a)) :
+    HasSum (fun v : B → A => ∏ a, f a (v a)) (∏ a, b a) := by
+  let e := Fintype.equivFin B
+  let E : (B → A) ≃ (Fin (Fintype.card B) → A) :=
+    Equiv.piCongrLeft' (fun _ : B => A) e
+  have hs := sum_fin_product (fun k => f (e.symm k)) (fun k => b (e.symm k))
+    (fun k => hn (e.symm k)) (fun k => hf (e.symm k))
+  have ht := E.hasSum_iff.mpr hs
+  have hb : (∏ k, b (e.symm k)) = ∏ a, b a := e.symm.prod_comp b
+  rw [hb] at ht
+  apply ht.congr_fun
+  intro v
+  exact (e.symm.prod_comp (fun a => f a (v a))).symm
+
+/-- The positive-frequency Lambert kernel of a labeled edge; both sides of
+the edge use natural powers and are defined on zero-coordinate faces. -/
+def edgeKernel (z : Four → ℂ) (e : Four × Four) : ℂ :=
+  ∑' r : ℕ, (r + 1 : ℂ) *
+    (sideProduct z 0 e ^ (r + 1) + sideProduct z 1 e ^ (r + 1)) /
+      (1 - (∏ j : Four, z j) ^ (r + 1))
+
+/-- The unpaired-current charge moment in the original charge coordinates. -/
+def chargeMoment (D : LatticeData) (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (S : Finset Four) (q : ℂ) : ℂ :=
+  ∑' β : Charge D, q ^ (chargeEnergy D β).toNat *
+    ∏ j ∈ S, (bilinear D (unitCharge D (i j)) β : ℂ)
+
+/-- The ordinary unsigned oscillator Euler product times the ten labeled matching
+moments and edge kernels, with no occupation signs or edge symmetrization. -/
+def thermalValue (D : LatticeData) (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) : ℂ :=
+  let q := ∏ j : Four, z j
+  (∏' m : ℕ, ((1 - q ^ (m + 1))⁻¹) ^ D.rank) *
+    ∑ M : PM4, chargeMoment D i (unpaired M) q *
+      ∏ e : edgeParam M, (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * edgeKernel z e.1
+
+private theorem edge_hasSum (D : LatticeData) (i : Four → Fin D.rank)
+    (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) (M : PM4) (e : edgeParam M) :
+    HasSum (edgeTerm D i z M e)
+      ((D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * edgeKernel z e.1) := by
+  let q := ∏ j : Four, z j
+  let L (ε : Fin 2) := ∑' r : ℕ,
+    (r + 1 : ℂ) * sideProduct z ε e.1 ^ (r + 1) / (1 - q ^ (r + 1))
+  let g : Fin 2 × (ℕ × ℕ) → ℂ := fun v => markedTerm q (sideProduct z v.1 e.1) v.2
+  have hn : Summable (fun v => ‖g v‖) :=
+    (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun v => norm_nonneg (g v))).2
+      ⟨fun ε => marked_summable q (sideProduct z ε e.1)
+        (product_norm_lt_one z hz) (side_product_norm_lt_one M e ε z hz),
+        Summable.of_finite⟩
+  have hrows := hn.of_norm.hasSum.prod_fiberwise (fun ε =>
+    marked_sum q (sideProduct z ε e.1) (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+      (side_product_norm_lt_one M e ε z hz))
+  have hv : (∑' v, g v) = edgeKernel z e.1 := by
+    rw [← hrows.tsum_eq, tsum_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_two]
+    have h0 := ((marked_summable q (sideProduct z 0 e.1) (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+      (side_product_norm_lt_one M e 0 z hz)).of_norm.prod).congr
+        (fun r => (marked_row q (sideProduct z 0 e.1) (product_norm_lt_one z hz) r).tsum_eq)
+    have h1 := ((marked_summable q (sideProduct z 1 e.1) (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+      (side_product_norm_lt_one M e 1 z hz)).of_norm.prod).congr
+        (fun r => (marked_row q (sideProduct z 1 e.1) (product_norm_lt_one z hz) r).tsum_eq)
+    dsimp [edgeKernel, q]
+    rw [← h0.tsum_add h1]
+    apply tsum_congr
+    intro r
+    ring
+  have ht := hn.of_norm.hasSum
+  rw [hv] at ht
+  have hout := (edgeIndexEquiv.hasSum_iff.mpr ht).mul_left
+    (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ)
+  change HasSum (fun v =>
+    (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * g (edgeIndexEquiv v)) _
+  exact hout
+
+private theorem matching_source_hasSum (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) (M : PM4) :
+    HasSum (fun x : Charge D × (Occ D × edgeData M) => sourceTerm D hD i z ⟨M, x⟩)
+      (chargeMoment D i (unpaired M) (∏ j : Four, z j) *
+        ((∑' d : Occ D, (∏ j : Four, z j) ^ oscillatorEnergy d) *
+          ∏ e : edgeParam M,
+            (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * edgeKernel z e.1)) := by
+  classical
+  let q := ∏ j : Four, z j
+  have hc := charge_norm D hD i (unpaired M) q (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+  have ho := occupation_norm D q (product_norm_lt_one z hz)
+  have he := norm_finite_product (fun e : edgeParam M => edgeTerm D i z M e)
+    (fun e => edge_norm D i z hz M e)
+  have hs := sum_finite_product (fun e : edgeParam M => edgeTerm D i z M e)
+    (fun e => (D.G (i e.1.1) (i e.1.2) : ℂ) * edgeKernel z e.1)
+    (fun e => edge_norm D i z hz M e) (fun e => edge_hasSum D i z hz M e)
+  have ht := ho.of_norm.hasSum.mul hs (ho.mul_norm he).of_norm
+  have hu := hc.of_norm.hasSum.mul ht (hc.mul_norm (ho.mul_norm he)).of_norm
+  apply hu.congr_fun
+  rintro ⟨β, d, v⟩
+  rw [source_term_factor]
+  simp only [edgeTerm, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, q]
+  ring
+
+private theorem source_total_value (D : LatticeData)
+    (hD : Matrix.PosDef (D.G.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ)))
+    (i : Four → Fin D.rank) (z : Four → ℂ) (hz : ∀ j, ‖z j‖ < 1) :
+    (∑' x : sourceIndex D, sourceTerm D hD i z x) = thermalValue D i z := by
+  classical
+  have hs := (source_norm D hD i z hz).of_norm.hasSum.sigma
+    (fun M => matching_source_hasSum D hD i z hz M)
+  rw [← hs.tsum_eq, tsum_fintype]

+  have hraw' : ((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] 𝓕 v := by
+    simpa [compactPiece, v] using hraw.symm
+  filter_upwards [hraw'] with w hw
+  rw [hw]
+  exact compact_fourier_Linf_bound u hr w
+theorem fourier_band_bound (u : LineL2) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+  let tail : LineL2 := u - compactPiece u hr.le
+  have hu : u = compactPiece u hr.le + tail := by
+    dsimp [tail]
+    abel
+  have hFourier : (𝓕 u : LineL2) =
+      (𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) + (𝓕 tail : LineL2) := by
+    calc
+      (𝓕 u : LineL2) = 𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le + tail) := congrArg 𝓕 hu
+      _ = (𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) + (𝓕 tail : LineL2) := by
+        change (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) (compactPiece u hr.le + tail) =
+          (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) (compactPiece u hr.le) +
+            (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) tail
+        exact (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ).map_add _ _
+  have hdecomp : ((𝓕 u : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      ((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) +
+        ((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
+    rw [hFourier]
+    exact Lp.coeFn_add _ _
+  have hcompact := compact_fourier_lp_ae_bound u hr
+  have hA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) :=
+    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
+  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ w : ℝ ∂volume,
+      w ∈ cyclesBand R →
+        ‖((𝓕 u : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ ≤
+          Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) +
+            ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := by
+    filter_upwards [hdecomp, hcompact] with w hw hc
+    intro hwband
+    rw [hw]
+    calc
+      ‖((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w +
+          ((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ ≤
+          ‖((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ +
+            ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
+      _ ≤ Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) +
+          ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := by gcongr
+  have htail : bandNorm (𝓕 tail : LineL2) R ≤
+      Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+    calc
+      bandNorm (𝓕 tail : LineL2) R ≤ ‖𝓕 tail‖ := band_norm_le_norm _ hR
+      _ = ‖tail‖ := by rw [Lp.norm_fourier_eq]
+      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+        exact compact_remainder_norm_le u hr hSupport hMoment
+  calc
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+        (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+          bandNorm (𝓕 tail) R :=
+      band_norm_le_of_ae_norm_le _ _ hR hA hpoint
+    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by gcongr
+theorem fourier_band_bound_exact (u : LineL2) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+  have hbase := fourier_band_bound u hr hR hSupport hMoment
+  have hS : 0 ≤ sourceEnergy u := source_energy_nonnegative u
+  have hroot :
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) =
+        Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) := by
+    calc
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) =
+          Real.sqrt (r * sourceEnergy u) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) := by
+            rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hr.le]
+      _ = Real.sqrt ((r * sourceEnergy u) * (2 * R)) := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg hr.le hS)]
+      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) := by
+            congr 1 <;> ring
+  calc
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+        (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+          Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := hbase
+    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+          Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by rw [hroot]
+def bandMass (f : LineL2) (R : ℝ) : ℝ := (bandNorm f R) ^ 2
+private lemma sq_add_le_two_sq (a b : ℝ) :
+    (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2 := by
+  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)]
+private lemma optimized_root_sum_sq {S m R r : ℝ}
+    (hS : 0 < S) (hm : 0 < m) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hr : r = Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S))) :
+    (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S) + Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S := by
+  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
+    rw [hr]
+    positivity
+  have hratio : 0 ≤ m / (2 * R * S) := by positivity
+  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = m / (2 * R * S) := by
+    calc
+      r ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S))) ^ 2 := by rw [hr]
+      _ = m / (2 * R * S) := Real.sq_sqrt hratio
+  have hfirst : (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S)) ^ 2 = 2 * R * r * S := by
+    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
+    positivity
+  have hsecond : (Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 = m / r := by
+    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
+    positivity
+  have hqr : Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * r = m / S := by
+    rw [hr]
+    calc
+      Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S)) =
+          Real.sqrt ((2 * R * m / S) * (m / (2 * R * S))) := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_mul' _ hratio]
+      _ = Real.sqrt ((m / S) ^ 2) := by
+            congr 1
+            field_simp
+      _ = m / S := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
+  have hqrS : Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * r * S = m := by
+    rw [hqr]
+    field_simp
+  have hqrS' : Real.sqrt (R * 2 * m / S) * r * S = m := by
+    rw [show R * 2 * m / S = 2 * R * m / S by ring]
+    exact hqrS
+  have hr2' : 2 * R * S * r ^ 2 = m := by
+    rw [hr2]
+    field_simp
+  calc
+    (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S) + Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 ≤
+        2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S)) ^ 2 +
+          2 * (Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 :=
+      sq_add_le_two_sq _ _
+    _ = 4 * R * r * S + 2 * m / r := by rw [hfirst, hsecond]; ring
+    _ = 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S := by
+      field_simp [ne_of_gt hrpos]
+      nlinarith [hr2', hqrS']
+theorem fourier_band_mass_ratio (u : LineL2) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))))
+    (hS : 0 < sourceEnergy u)
+    (hm : 0 < firstPositionMoment u) :
+    bandMass (𝓕 u : LineL2) R / sourceEnergy u ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) := by
+  let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt
+    (firstPositionMoment u / (2 * R * sourceEnergy u))
+  have hr : 0 < r := by
+    dsimp [r]
+    positivity
+  have hbound := fourier_band_bound_exact u hr hR hSupport hMoment
+  have hsum : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+      Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by positivity
+  have hnorm : 0 ≤ bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R := norm_nonneg _
+  have hsq : bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ^ 2 ≤
+      (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r)) ^ 2 := by
+    nlinarith
+  have hopt := optimized_root_sum_sq
+    (S := sourceEnergy u) (m := firstPositionMoment u) (R := R) (r := r)
+    hS hm hR (by rfl)
+  have hmass : bandMass (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) *
+        sourceEnergy u := by
+    unfold bandMass
+    calc
+      bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ^ 2 ≤
+          (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+            Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r)) ^ 2 := hsq
+      _ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) *
+          sourceEnergy u := by
+        simpa using hopt
+  apply (div_le_iff₀ hS).2
+  simpa [mul_comm] using hmass
+/-- Signed logarithmic integration after the nonnegative layer-cake payment.
+The two integrability hypotheses are deliberately explicit: the negative part
+must be established by the layer-cake argument, while the positive part is the
+actual form-domain supplier on the Gamma source path. -/
+theorem signed_log_lower_bound_of_layer_cake
+    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {S A : ℝ}
+    (hA : 0 < A)
+    (hMassInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hMass : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = S)
+    (hLogInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hNegInt : Integrable
+      (fun x : ℝ => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hNegBound : (∫ x : ℝ,
+      max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * S) :
+    S * (Real.log A - 2) ≤
+      ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * q x
+  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.log A * q x
+  have hq_nonneg : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, 0 ≤ q x :=
+    Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
+  have hq_int : Integrable q volume := by simpa [q] using hMassInt
+  have hg_int : Integrable g volume := by simpa [g, q] using hNegInt
+  have hc_int : Integrable c volume := by
+    simpa [c] using hq_int.const_mul (Real.log A)
+  have hsub_int : Integrable (fun x => c x - g x) volume := hc_int.sub hg_int
+  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
+      c x - g x ≤ Real.log |x| * q x := by
+    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume (0 : ℝ), hq_nonneg] with x hx0 hqx
+    have hxabs : 0 < |x| := abs_pos.mpr hx0
+    have hlog : Real.log |x| = Real.log A - Real.log (A / |x|) := by
+      rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hA) (ne_of_gt hxabs)]
+      ring
+    dsimp [c, g, q]
+    rw [hlog]
+    have hmax : Real.log (A / |x|) ≤ max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 :=
+      le_max_left _ _
+    nlinarith
+  have hmono : (∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x) ≤
+      ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * q x :=
+    integral_mono_ae hsub_int (by simpa [q] using hLogInt) hpoint
+  have hsub_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x) =
+      Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := by
+    rw [integral_sub hc_int hg_int, integral_const_mul, hMass]
+  have hneg : Real.log A * S - 2 * S ≤
+      Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := by
+    dsimp [g, q] at hNegBound ⊢
+    linarith
+  calc
+    S * (Real.log A - 2) = Real.log A * S - 2 * S := by ring
+    _ ≤ Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := hneg
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x := hsub_eq.symm
+    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * q x := hmono
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by rfl
+def angularUnitary (f : ℝ → ℂ) (ξ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
+  (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))
+theorem angular_unitary_mass_preserved {f : ℝ → ℂ}
+    (hInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume) :
+    (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖angularUnitary f ξ‖ ^ 2) =
+      ∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hπ : 0 < (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) := by positivity
+  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hπ
+  have hcongr : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖angularUnitary f ξ‖ ^ 2) =
+      (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
+        ‖f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))‖ ^ 2) := by
+    funext ξ
+    simp only [angularUnitary, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
+    have hsqrt_norm : ‖Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)‖ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) :=
+      abs_of_pos hsqrt
+    rw [hsqrt_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hπ.le]
+    ring
+  rw [hcongr, integral_const_mul]
+  change (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
+      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))‖ ^ 2) = _
+  have hcomp := MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_div
+    (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) (2 * Real.pi)
+  rw [hcomp]
+  rw [abs_of_pos hπ]
+  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
+  field_simp
+private theorem lp_mass_eq_norm_sq (u : LineL2) :
+    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hnorm : ‖u‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := by
+    rw [Lp.norm_def]
+    change lpNorm (u : ℝ → ℂ) 2 volume = _
+    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal
+      (f := (u : ℝ → ℂ))
+      (μ := volume)
+      (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))
+      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
+      ((Lp.memLp u).aestronglyMeasurable)]
+    norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_two]
+  rw [hnorm]
+  exact (Real.sq_sqrt (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _)).symm
+private theorem source_energy_eq_norm_sq (u : LineL2) :
+    sourceEnergy u = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
+  exact lp_mass_eq_norm_sq u
+private theorem bandMass_eq_setIntegral (f : LineL2) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
+    bandMass f R = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hnorm : ‖bandPiece f R‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖bandPiece f R x‖ ^ 2 := by
+    rw [lp_mass_eq_norm_sq]
+  have hcoe : (bandPiece f R : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      (cyclesBand R).indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ) :=
+    (bandMemLp f R).coeFn_toLp
+  change ‖bandPiece f R‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  rw [hnorm]
+  calc
+    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖bandPiece f R x‖ ^ 2) =
+        ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(cyclesBand R).indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ) x‖ ^ 2 := by
+      apply integral_congr_ae
+      filter_upwards [hcoe] with x hx
+      rw [hx]
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, (cyclesBand R).indicator (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) x := by
+      apply integral_congr_ae
+      filter_upwards with x
+      by_cases hx : x ∈ cyclesBand R <;> simp [hx]
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+      change (∫ x : ℝ, (Ioo (-R) R).indicator (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) x) = _
+      rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
+      rfl
+/- The missing negative layer is now proved from the whole band profile.  The
+   density measure packages the actual Fourier square mass, so the layer-cake
+   tails are the genuine band masses rather than a scalar surrogate. -/
+theorem nonnegative_layer_cake_bound
+    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {S m A : ℝ}
+    (hA : 0 < A) (hS : 0 < S) (hm : 0 < m)
+    (hAeq : A = S / (32 * m))
+    (hMassInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hMass : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = S)
+    (hProfile : ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R →
+      (∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤
+        4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S) :
+    Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
+      max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume ∧
+      (∫ x : ℝ, max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * S := by
+  classical
+  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0
+  let qE : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q x)
+  let μ : Measure ℝ := volume.withDensity qE
+  have hq_int : Integrable q volume := by simpa [q] using hMassInt
+  have hq_ae : AEMeasurable q volume := hq_int.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
+  have hqE_ae : AEMeasurable qE volume := by
+    exact hq_ae.ennreal_ofReal
+  have hmeas : Measurable h := by
+    dsimp [h]
+    fun_prop
+  have hmeas_ae : AEMeasurable h μ := hmeas.aemeasurable
+  have hnonneg : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x :=
+    Eventually.of_forall (fun x => le_max_right _ _)
+  have hlayer :
+      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x) ∂μ) =
+        ∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, μ {x : ℝ | t < h x} :=
+    lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt μ hnonneg hmeas_ae
+  have hleft :
+      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x * q x)) =
+        ∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x) ∂μ := by
+    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul₀ hqE_ae hmeas.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal]
+    apply lintegral_congr_ae
+    filter_upwards with x
+    dsimp [qE, q]
+    calc
+      ENNReal.ofReal (h x * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) =
+          ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2 * h x) := by rw [mul_comm]
+      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (h x) :=
+        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)
+  have htail_bound : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi 0)),
+      μ {x : ℝ | t < h x} ≤
+        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * Real.sqrt (2 * (A * Real.exp (-t)) * m / S) * S) := by
+    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
+    have htpos : 0 < t := ht
+    let R : ℝ := A * Real.exp (-t)
+    have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
+    have hset : {x : ℝ | t < h x} =ᵐ[μ] cyclesBand R := by
+      filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne μ (0 : ℝ)] with x hx0
+      have hxabs : 0 < |x| := abs_pos.mpr hx0
+      apply propext
+      constructor
+      · intro htx
+        have htx' : t < Real.log (A / |x|) := by
+          rcases (lt_max_iff.mp htx) with htx' | htx'
+          · exact htx'
+          · linarith
+        have hexp : Real.exp t < A / |x| :=
+          (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (div_pos hA hxabs)).mp htx'
+        have hmul : Real.exp t * |x| < A :=
+          (lt_div_iff₀ hxabs).mp hexp
+        have htarget : |x| < A * Real.exp (-t) := by
+          have hdiv : |x| < A / Real.exp t := by
+            exact (lt_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos t)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmul)
+          simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg] using hdiv
+        simpa [cyclesBand, R, abs_lt] using htarget
+      · intro htx
+        have htarget : |x| < A * Real.exp (-t) := by
+          simpa [cyclesBand, R, abs_lt] using htx
+        have hmul : Real.exp t * |x| < A := by
+          have hdiv : |x| < A / Real.exp t := by
+            simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg] using htarget
+          simpa [mul_comm] using (lt_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos t)).mp hdiv
+        have hexp : Real.exp t < A / |x| :=
+          (lt_div_iff₀ hxabs).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmul)
+        have htx' : t < Real.log (A / |x|) :=

+
+# The subgraph core conjecture for connected graphs
+
+## Verified locator
+
+Dinesh Pandey and Kamal Lochan Patra, *Some new central parts of connected graphs*,
+arXiv:2110.00738v1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.00738v1 and
+https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.00738v1. The paper's page 1 fixes finite simple
+connected undirected graphs, cut vertices and blocks. Definition 3.23 on page 9
+counts connected subgraphs containing a vertex, and Conjecture 3.25 on page 9
+states that the subgraph core is contained in a block.
+
+## Native statement
+
+For a graph G, f_G(v) is the number of actual connected subgraphs containing v,
+with each subgraph retaining its vertex and edge choices. The subgraph core is
+the set of vertices maximizing f_G. A block is a maximal connected subgraph
+without a cut vertex under the native subgraph convention. The formal result
+keeps singleton graphs, bridge edges, empty deletion, and every finite order;
+it adds no cutoff and does not replace the count by induced or spanning
+subgraphs.
+
+## Formal resolution
+
+`D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result` proves the exact
+whole statement. Its proof uses the existing De–Patra connected-subgraph
+counting interfaces, an attachment injection for subgraphs omitting a root,
+an exact one-root gluing inequality, and the path hull of all maximizers.
+`SubgraphCoreHull.exists_no_cut_cover` is a consumed helper for that proof and
+is not a second external problem or a separate resolution claim.
+
+The result is a repository formalization of this one cited conjecture. It makes
+no priority, originality, worldwide-openness, or empirical claim. The public
+Reg escape audits for the two new declarations remain unfinished under the
+precise linked-issue exception recorded at
+https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing/issues/23700#issuecomment-6499492075;
+that exception is not registration evidence.

+Question 3 on printed page 11 asks for the least number of open
+orthogonality-free subsets covering the real unit two-sphere, and more
+generally for estimates of the open orthogonality covering number in
+other dimensions. Here orthogonality is the standard Euclidean inner
+product relation on the actual unit sphere.
+
+The construction in `D5/S3/Geometry/Orthogonality/RationalSixAxisCover`
+uses the six rational axes $(1,\pm2,0)$, $(0,1,\pm2)$ and
+$(\pm2,0,1)$ and the strict superlevels $2\langle x,v\rangle^2>5$.
+Its nonnegative polynomial certificate yields a squared projection of
+at least three for every unit vector. Bessel's inequality excludes an
+orthogonal pair from each superlevel. The corresponding Blueprint
+gives the full construction and identity. The cited paper is the
+source of the question. The six-set upper bound has classical antecedents
+in antipodal icosahedral coverings; see P. W. Fowler, T. Tarnai and
+Zs. Gáspár, *From circle packing to covering on a sphere with antipodal
+constraints* (2002), DOI: [10.1098/rspa.2002.0990](https://doi.org/10.1098/rspa.2002.0990).
+The explicit rational coordinates and polynomial certificate above describe
+this repository's implementation, as specified by
+https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing/issues/23716.
+This is an upper bound only. No attribution of the certificate to
+Feldman--Wilce, lower-bound conclusion, mathematical-priority claim or
+complete resolution of Question 3 is made here.

+\qquad

+$$

+       +l_i\log\frac{1-r}{1+\epsilon_c},\qquad
+J=\{i:\tau-w<W_i\le\tau+w\}.
+\tag{121.4}
+$$
+
+以精确分数相等分组 $J=\bigsqcup_jJ_j$，$C_j=|J_j|$。
+取唯一共同赔率乘子 $h_x$，使
+
+$$
+p_i=\frac{e^{W_i+h_x}}{1+e^{W_i+h_x}},\qquad \sum_i p_i=q.
+\tag{121.5}
+$$
+
+组内 $p_i=p_j$。令 $\mathsf Q_x$ 为这些辅助独立 Bernoulli 的乘积律，
+$\pi_i$ 为原完整固定 $q$ 后验的包含概率，$\mu_j=\sum_{i\in J_j}\pi_i$。
+记 $e_k(u_A)=\sum_{I\subseteq A,\,|I|=k}\prod_{i\in I}u_i$，非法指标处取零。
+原计数后验为
+
+$$
+P_x(m)=\frac{e_{q-\sum_jm_j}((e^{W_i})_{i\notin J})}
+ {e_q((e^{W_i})_i)}
+ \prod_j\binom{C_j}{m_j}e^{W_jm_j}.
+\tag{121.6}
+$$
+
+其支持取全部使右侧为正的 $0\le m_j\le C_j$ 元组。
+在任何后续幂和中，式 (121.6) 的整个质量连同全部二项多重度一起取幂。
+独立 Bernoulli 在总数为 $q$ 下条件化恰给这个后验。特别地，置
+
+$$
+Q_x(m)=\prod_j\binom{C_j}{m_j}p_j^{m_j}(1-p_j)^{C_j-m_j},\quad
+D(m)=\sum_j(m_j-C_jp_j),\quad\mathcal D(m)=D(m)/B,
+$$
+
+$$
+\ell(m)=\log\frac{\mathsf Q_x(S_{J^c}=q-\sum_jm_j)}
+ {\mathsf Q_x(S_{\mathrm{all}}=q)};
+\qquad P_x(m)=e^{\ell(m)}Q_x(m).
+\tag{121.7}
+$$
+
+在整个盒均可行的纤维上，$\ell$ 在整个盒有限。
+这正是谱边界式 (68.3)–(68.5)、(70.6) 的完整计数对象。
+
+定义
+
+$$
+v_j=\frac{C_jp_j(1-p_j)}{B^2},\quad
+ e_j=\frac{\mu_j-C_jp_j}{B},\quad
+V=\sum_jv_j,\quad
+E(m)=\sum_j((m_j-\mu_j)/B)^2,\quad
+T_x(m)=\frac{E(m)-V}{\sqrt\delta}.
+\tag{121.8}
+$$
+
+空组补零。给定 $\sigma>0$，令
+
+$$
+\lambda_y(m)=\frac{(T_x(m)-y)^2}{2\sigma^2},\quad
+P_x^y(m)=\frac{P_x(m)e^{-\lambda_y(m)}}
+ {\sum_uP_x(u)e^{-\lambda_y(u)}},\quad
+C3_x(y)=\mathbb E_{P_x^y}
+ \left[-\log P_x^y-\mathbb E_{P_x^y}(-\log P_x^y)\right]^3.
+\tag{121.9}
+$$
+
